Question
========
What is mosaic plagiarism?

Answerlist
----------
* writing original text based on another author's idea
* combining sources without citing each one of them
* citing more than one source per statement
* using source that has been proven to contain plagiarism


Solution
========
Mosaic plagiarism is combining sources without citing each one of them.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
